rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: moveup:1.3: can: The header on p502-strip0.jpg prints the metre 11.11.11.5. On p502-strip800.jpg system 3 and p502-strip1600.jpg system 4, stanza 1's line 3 sings 11 syllables and line 4 sings 5 (the other stanzas' last lines are 5 too). The moved word makes them 12 and 4, which breaks the metre; the capital on the moved name alone would not show it.
